keywords: EIP-8296 固定截止状态分层
summary: 当晚 ACDC #180 讨论把 builder 存款和退出拆到独立合约的 EIP-8282，它可能让 Glamsterdam 推迟数月，会上提到可考虑拆分升级。EIP-8130 让 `authenticateActor` 返回完整授权面的修改合并。pcaversaccio 认为 Sign-In with Ethereum 让用户习惯随手签名，造成签名疲劳。weiihann 提交 EIP-8297 分区二叉树。

items.title: pcaversaccio：Sign-In with Ethereum 其实是个糟糕的主意
items.note: 21:14，它训练人们随时签名、造成签名疲劳，签名本应被视为危险的特殊事件。
items.title_en: pcaversaccio: Sign-In with Ethereum is actually a terrible idea
items.note_en: 21:14: it trains people to sign messages all the time and creates signing fatigue, when a signature should be treated as a dangerous, special event.

items.title: 新 EIP：分区二叉树
items.note: （weiihann）提交，即 EIP-8297：用一棵 32 字节键的二叉树替换十六叉 Patricia trie，账户树与存储树并为一棵并包含合约代码；账户数据按 256 个一组拆成独立叶子以获得局部性；键的高 4 位是分区标识，区分账户头、合约代码和存储。
items.note_en: (weiihann), submitted; this is EIP-8297. It replaces the hexary Patricia tries with one binary tree keyed by 32 bytes, merging account and storage tries and holding contract code; account data is split into independent leaves grouped by 256 for locality; the high 4 bits of each key are a zone id for account headers, contract code or storage.

summary_en: In the evening ACDC #180 discussed EIP-8282, which moves builder deposits and exits into separate contracts and could delay Glamsterdam by months; splitting the upgrade was mentioned as an option. The EIP-8130 change making `authenticateActor` return the full authorization surface was merged. pcaversaccio argued that Sign-In with Ethereum trains users to sign casually and creates signing fatigue. weiihann submitted EIP-8297, a partitioned binary tree.
